name: Simon Orchestra
description: Six instruments play a tune on a 3D stage and the child plays it back, longer, faster, then backwards.

about.concept: Working memory and attention. Six instruments on a 3D stage play a tune and the child plays it back; each round adds a note, so the span of what can be held in mind grows with practice.
about.progression: Short sequences at a slow pace lead to longer ones, faster ones, and sequences played back in reverse, which asks for the whole pattern to be held and transformed.
